history.new: As a conjecture, low confidence (Historian audit 2026-10-18, reviews/historian_C03_C10.md).

Complete SAT enumeration for N <= 9 (Skeptic N <= 16). In cycle C13 16 of the 17 laws were PROVED to have exactly the stated finite spectra - x(yz) = ((zx)x)y and x(yz) = ((xy)z)x in Lean (CLM-C13-04), the rest by the sound offset-closure prover (CLM-C13-06). Only x(yz) = y((yx)z) remains open (spectrum {1,2} supported up to N = 12).
history.old: Complete SAT enumeration for N <= 9; for all but x(yz) = y((yx)z) every model found is affine, and the affine spectrum is provably the stated finite set for all N (the affine conditions are polynomial congruences in a). Open - excluding non-affine models for N >= 10.

statement:
The seven laws x(yz) = ((zx)x)y, x(yz) = ((zx)y)x, x(yz) = ((zy)x)x, (xy)z = y((zx)y), (xy)z = y((zy)x),
(xy)z = z((yx)z), (xy)z = z((yz)x) have anchored models exactly for N in {1, 3}; the ten laws x(yz) = y((yx)z),
x(yz) = ((xx)y)z, x(yz) = ((xx)z)y, x(yz) = ((xy)x)z, x(yz) = ((xy)y)z, x(yz) = ((xy)z)x, x(yz) = ((xy)z)y,
x(yz) = ((xz)x)y, x(yz) = ((xz)y)x, x(yz) = ((xz)y)y have anchored models exactly for N in {1, 2}.
title: Laws with finite anchored spectra {1, 2} and {1, 3}
